full_judgment: 2. Shor facts necessary to dispose the appeal are that the appellant as the sole plaintiff filed Title Suit No.10 of 2005 in the Court of the District Judge, Dhaka under section 21 of the Trade Marks Act, 1940 praying for a decree for permanent injunction against the defendants restraining them from manufacturing storing selling or in any way dealing with the washing soap with the trade mark (cPv) together to the design attached to the packet used for marketing of washing soaps as shown in schedule "B" to the plaint. In the suit, the plaintiff filed an application for temporary injunction. Hearing both the parties, the learned Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka allowed the application by his order dated 21-06-2005.
